description: Source code implementing the 'ServeCommand', a command-line interface command for running the Swabble service in foreground mode, handling configuration, speech streaming, wake word detection, and logging.

classes.name: ServeCommand
classes.description: A command-line command for serving the Swabble voice assistant, managing configuration, speech processing, and wake word detection.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Asynchronously starts the speech pipeline, processes streaming speech segments, and handles wake-word detection and command execution.

methods.name: matchesWake
methods.description: Checks if the speech text matches the configured wake word or its aliases.

methods.name: stripWake
methods.description: Removes the wake word or its aliases from the speech text.
